plain: A debt or claim attached to property

webster.text: A load; any thing that impedes motion, or renders it difficult and laborious; clog; impediment.

more.text: Load or burden on an estate; a legal claim on an estate, for the discharge of which the estate is liable.

example.quote: To this it may be answered that the produce of imposts on commerce, which all agree to vest in Congress, together with the immense tracts of land at their disposal, will rapidly lessen and eventually discharge the present encumbrances.
